# PalBreed — Palworld Breeding Calculator

> Free Palworld breeding calculator: find any parent combo, reverse-lookup a target Pal, and calculate cake ingredients. No account, no ads, no paywall.

## PalBreed key facts
- PalBreed is a free fan-made tool for Palworld players. All tools are free: no account, no payment, no ads.
- It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Pocketpair, Inc. Game content is © Pocketpair, Inc.
- Breeding data is community-sourced from tylercamp/palcalc (MIT license): 299 Pals and 44,851 parent combinations.
- Breeding mechanics: each Pal has a hidden breeding value. The offspring is the Pal whose breeding value is closest to the average of the two parents' values.
- Unique combos: some parent pairs always produce the same offspring regardless of gender or stats. Example: Relaxaurus × Sparkit always produces Jetragon.
- Cake recipe: 1 Cake = 5 Flour + 8 Red Berries + 7 Milk + 8 Eggs + 2 Honey.
- One cake is consumed per breeding attempt in the Breeding Farm.

## Core tools
- [Breeding Calculator](https://palbreed.space/tools/breeding-calculator/): Select two parents to see the offspring, or switch to reverse lookup to find every parent pair for a target Pal.
- [Cake Calculator](https://palbreed.space/tools/cake-calculator/): Convert your planned number of breeding attempts into exact cake ingredient amounts (Flour, Red Berries, Milk, Eggs, Honey).

## Pages
- [Home](https://palbreed.space/): PalBreed home page with the quick breeding search.
- [Pal List](https://palbreed.space/pals/): Browse all 299 Pals with search and A-Z filtering.
- [FAQ](https://palbreed.space/faq/): Answers about Palworld breeding mechanics, unique combos, cake recipes, and using PalBreed.
- [About](https://palbreed.space/about/): What PalBreed is, data source, and disclaimer.
- [Privacy Policy](https://palbreed.space/privacy/): What data PalBreed collects (analytics with consent) and how it is handled.
- [Terms](https://palbreed.space/terms/): Terms of use and content disclaimer.
